title: Human rights lawyer Noura Erakat arrested at hearing against Israel Bonds
content: Human rights lawyer Noura Erakat arrested at hearing against Israel Bonds | Protests | Al Jazeera Toggle Play Human rights lawyer Noura Erakat arrested at hearing against Israel Bonds Palestinian human rights lawyer Noura Erakat was arrested in Florida after speaking against a billion-dollar investment in Israel Bonds during a public budget hearing. At least 100 residents protesting the investment were also forced to leave the hearing.
